authorityBoundary: This 2014 textbook is supplemental study support, not current scoring or diagnostic authority. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 controls scoring and technical definitions; ICSD-3-TR controls current diagnostic classification; current AASM pediatric testing/treatment protocols and current AAST technical guidance control version-sensitive procedures; physician orders, facility policy, and current medication information govern care when newer guidance differs.
